summary: Layer 1B expands the restaurant beverage/private-label supply node toward underfollowed public companies that may sit behind restaurant, hospitality, convenience-store, and foodservice beverage menus. The strongest direct underfollowed candidates from available evidence are Westrock Coffee and Farmer Brothers, both linked to coffee/tea/extract or foodservice beverage supply but with high execution, leverage, profitability, or scale risk. TreeHouse Foods is included as a second-order private-label consolidator because it acquired Farmer Brothers' Northlake facility and non-direct-store-delivery business.
